eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 International Conference on Advancement and Innovation: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI2ML)
eventDetail.sponsors: Islamabad Section; National University of Sciences and Technology (NUST)
eventDetail.keywords: Artificial Intelligence,Machine Learning,Deep Learning,Generative AI,LLMs,Agentic AI,Ethical AI ,Foundation Models ,Responsible AI,Applications of AI,
eventDetail.scope: The conference focuses on advancements and innovations in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, spanning foundational methods, data-centric development, and rigorous evaluation; foundation and generative models including multimodal intelligence; and agentic, trustworthy, and human-centered AI systems. It emphasizes reliable deployment through MLOps and benchmarking, responsible AI through governance, privacy, security, and assurance, and impactful applications across healthcare, climate and sustainability, mobility, finance, hardware/EDA, and digital identity (SSI) for secure, real-world AI adoption.
